title: My doorbell cam showed a man outside for 6 hours
style_prompt: cinematic horror film still, dark, moody, low key lighting, 35mm film grain, desaturated, realistic, suburban American house at night, no text, no watermark
hook_text: My doorbell app said someone had been on my porch for six hours

scenes.narration: My doorbell app said someone had been standing on my porch for six hours.

shots.prompt: smart doorbell app notification glowing on a phone screen held in a dark bedroom, close up, no faces

scenes.narration: Problem is, I'd been home all day. Nobody rang.

shots.prompt: quiet suburban living room in the evening, closed front door at the end of a hallway, lamp glow, nobody visible

scenes.narration: I opened the live feed. Snow everywhere. A man stood facing my door. His breath didn't fog in the freezing air.

shots.prompt: grainy night vision doorbell camera view of a snowy front porch, fisheye lens, empty steps
grainy doorbell camera fisheye view of a tall man standing on a snowy porch seen from behind, facing the door, dark silhouette, no face

scenes.narration: He wasn't wearing a coat. Or shoes. He hadn't moved since noon. I pressed the talk button. Hello? Can I help you?

shots.prompt: close up of a thumb pressing a glowing microphone button on a smartphone screen in a dark room, no face
grainy doorbell camera view of a barefoot man in thin clothes standing motionless in snow on a porch, seen from behind

scenes.narration: Slowly, he lifted his head to the camera. And whispered through the speaker: don't look behind you. I've been trying to warn you since noon.

shots.prompt: extreme close up of a doorbell camera lens glowing blue in the dark, snow falling, reflections
smartphone speaker waveform glowing in a dark hand, cold light, no face

scenes.narration: Then my phone buzzed. Person detected. Living room.

shots.prompt: smartphone lit with an alert in a trembling hand in a pitch black bedroom, no face

scenes.narration: On the feed, the man pressed his palms against my door. Please. Open up. It's already in here with you.

shots.prompt: grainy doorbell camera view, close up of two pale bare hands pressed flat against a wooden front door, dark sleeves, falling snow, frame cut off above the shoulders, no face

scenes.narration: Behind me, the floorboards creaked. And something exhaled, right against my neck.

shots.prompt: dark hallway seen from inside a bedroom doorway, long shadow stretching across wooden floor, horror film still

scenes.narration: So tell me. Do you open the door, or hide?

shots.prompt: smart doorbell app notification glowing on a phone screen held in a dark bedroom, close up, no faces
